adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a new, nontrivial helper `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts` that conditionally changes validation behavior based on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, and it is newly wired into multiple integrations (e.g., Google, Office365, Salesforce, Zoom via imports and usage changes). The PR diff does not add any corresponding test files/changes to cover (a) the schema-switching branch and (b) malformed/partial token responses (e.g., safeParse failure paths, missing refresh_token fallback). While we can’t prove the repo has zero tests overall, it’s verifiable that this PR introduces this branching logic without adding tests alongside it.
